sources: same 31 available features as the lagged multisystem component; no SST or new source
selection: lowest reconstructed inner RMSE; earliest epoch on ties; refit from seed on full outer training window for that epoch count
loss: unweighted pixel MSE in mm/day anomalies; mean over complete monthly maps
scaling: per-channel mean and standard deviation fitted on training maps only; standard deviation floor 1e-6
augmentation: none: do not flip geography or mix months across temporal boundaries
reconstruction: maximum(0, training_rainfall_climatology + predicted_anomaly); no tuned residual scale
comparison_limit: same source information and target months; U-Net uses all pixels in monthly maps, baseline trees use 5000 sampled pixels per month
prospective_registration: separate future protocol after historical development; never alter the existing hybrid registry
